title: 第173章 你我夫妻，何至于此？
slug: 满级小李飞刀我在水浒当判官
content_zh:
“干（gān）女儿？”

李逸闻言，一时竟没反应过来！

以前他不过是蔡京的孙女婿，现在要是蔡京认了扈三娘做干女儿，那他不是成了蔡京女婿了？

好家伙，这还给自己提了一辈儿！

看着龙脊山一行人，驾着龙背桥，漂浮在湖面上，向着沙洲而去，在岸边的另外三支队伍，此时死死盯着龙脊山一行人，看看会不会发生什么危险。

一边在心里琢磨这“大事儿”是好事儿还是坏事儿，喻嘉言一边捏着厚厚的信封走向后院儿。

“嘶呀——”四臂人发出一声尖锐的叫声，像是车辆在行驶时猛地急刹发出的声音。

“皇兄，你这是几个意思？”墨南宸恨不得上前把这两只紧握在一起的手分离开来，但是理智战胜了疯狂。

有三人相助兰楚，鬼英娘娘等人哪里有半点优势？只一阵间，鬼英娘娘的四名手下便被击退，鬼英娘娘也被迫停手。

明城和陶氏很默契的谁也没有回答明月后一个问题，明城嘿嘿傻笑着说了一句“看完了”，陶氏则一脸红晕的转开了视线。

和上一个场景一样的，她同样满身血污，这次，手中拿着的是一把长剑。

顾白齐轻笑，他纵身朝着黎相思奔去，但没有正面去跟黎相思硬钢，反而在黎相思身边饶了几圈，最后选定在黎相思侧面突击。

对他而言，谁当上护法其实无关紧要。能当上护法的，就是有本事的人。

位于半山腰的山谷被休整平整，一座座完全由湛青石打造的高大建筑竞相建起。

“好了好了，我们走吧！”此时杨雅诺哼哼了一声，便对鹿孜然说道。

但念在马忠主意甚多，他们都觉得可能有什么后招，因此没放在心上。

周胤赶紧给孙匡使个眼色，示意他看周围那些持刀弄枪虎视眈眈的士兵们。

而且就如今的自己来看的话，这边刘佳宁他也是清楚的知道，如果可以的话自己这边肯定是要努力变强才是。

因为在很多人看来，人类捕杀动物，就好像牛要吃草、狼要吃肉一般，本就是天经地义没人会指责的事。

一声脆响，道信从李察腰间拔出了黑蝉，黑蝉出鞘的瞬间一股阴冷的气息自剑身上散发，显得和这大殿氛围格格不入。

如果不是逼不得已，他并不像和这几个年轻人发生冲突，毕竟，楚云端和慕萧萧都是天神身边的要人。遇到这样的人，能交好还是交好。

尽管比不上霞之丘学姐那样的身材，但至少完全不逊色于加藤惠。

千巨空沉稳的话语一开，所有人都回神过来，他们很清楚这里谁是主人，谁才是决定结果的人。

洛丽塔有虚拟时空的加持，探测能力比楚风强上不很多，她只须运转了一下时空的追溯本源，就能得出战帝身上的极恶黑暗气息的来源，并不是直接的接触。

“有倒是有，只是天子一怒浮尸千里，谁又能保证他吴宸轩不会趁机把咱们斩尽杀绝呢？”那个胖子也豁出去了，如果没有万全之策，他决计不会参与下去了。

如果，不是有着独自意志的存在，那么或者弥辰，也是无法做到，在这样的痛苦之中，寻找到自己的传承，创造出自己的传承来了。
content_en:
"Gān my daughter?"

When Li Yi heard this, he didn't react for a moment!

In the past, he was just Cai Jing's grandson-in-law. Now if Cai Jing accepts Hu Sanniang as his goddaughter, wouldn't he become Cai Jing's son-in-law?

Good guy, this has saved me a lifetime!

Watching the Longji Mountain group, riding the Longbei Bridge, floating on the lake towards the sandbank, the other three teams on the shore were staring at the Longji Mountain group to see if any danger would occur.

While wondering in his mind whether this "big thing" was a good thing or a bad thing, Yu Jiayan walked to the backyard holding the thick envelope.

"Hiss--" The four-armed man made a sharp cry, like the sound of a vehicle braking suddenly while driving.

"Brother Imperial, what do you mean by this?" Mo Nanchen wanted to step forward and separate the two clasped hands, but reason defeated madness.

There are three people helping Lan Chu. How can Empress Guiying and others have any advantage?In just a moment, four of Guiying Empress's men were repulsed, and Guiying Empress was forced to stop.

Mingcheng and Tao had a tacit understanding and neither of them answered Mingyue's last question. Mingcheng giggled and said, "I've finished reading." Tao turned away with a blush on his face.

Like the previous scene, she was also covered in blood. This time, she was holding a long sword in her hand.

Gu Baiqi chuckled, and he jumped towards Li Xiangsi, but instead of confronting Li Xiangsi head-on, he circled around Li Xiangsi for a few times, and finally decided to attack from Li Xiangsi's side.

To him, it didn't really matter who became the protector.Those who can become Dharma protectors are those who are capable.

The valley halfway up the mountain was leveled, and tall buildings made entirely of azure stone were built one after another.

"Okay, okay, let's go!" At this time, Yang Yanuo snorted and said to Lu Ziran.

However, since Ma Zhong had so many ideas, they all felt that there might be some back-up plan, so they didn't take it to heart.

Zhou Yin quickly gave Sun Kuang a wink, telling him to look at the soldiers around him who were eyeing him with knives and guns.

And looking at it now, Liu Jianing clearly knows that if possible, he must work hard to become stronger.

Because in the eyes of many people, humans killing animals is just like cattle eating grass and wolves eating meat. It is a matter of course that no one will criticize.

With a crisp sound, Daoxin pulled out the black cicada from Richard's waist. The moment the black cicada was unsheathed, a cold aura emanated from the sword, which seemed incompatible with the atmosphere of the hall.

If he was not forced to do so, he would not have a conflict with these young people. After all, Chu Yunduan and Mu Xiaoxiao were both important people around the god.When you meet such a person, it's better to make friends with them.

Although she is not as tall as Kasumigaoka-senpai, she is at least not inferior to Kato Megumi.

As soon as Qian Jukong spoke calmly, everyone came to their senses. They knew very well who was the master here and who was the one who decided the outcome.

Lolita has the blessing of virtual time and space, and her detection ability is not much better than Chu Feng. She only needs to trace the origin of time and space to find out that the source of the extremely evil dark aura on the War Emperor is not direct contact.

"Yes, there is. It's just that the emperor is angry and his body is thousands of miles away. Who can guarantee that Wu Chenxuan will not take the opportunity to kill us all?" The fat man also risked his life. If there was no perfect strategy, he would not participate anymore.

If he were not a being with his own will, then Michen would not be able to find and create his own inheritance in such pain.
title_en: Chapter 173 Why are you and I like this?
